newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Soccer-Venables makes nine changes for Tahiti World Cup Match.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Venables makes nine changes for Tahiti World Cup Match.

text.p: Australia soccer coach Terry Venables has made nine changes for the Oceania group World Cup qualifier against Tahiti on Friday.
Only midfielders Aurelio Vidmar and Ned Zelic have kept their places from the side that routed Solomon Islands 13-0 in the tournament opener at Parramatta Stadium on Wednesday.
A similar scoreline is expected against Tahiti, who are ranked 160th by world governing body, FIFA.
Vidmar, who plays for Tenerife in Spain, has taken over the captaincy from Adelaide City defender Alex Tobin.
Australia and New Zealand are virtually certain to win their respective qualifying groups to set up a Oceania play-off over two legs in June and July.
The winner will then face an Asian opponent in a final qualifier for a place in next year's World Cup finals in France.
Australia - Zeljko Kalac, Kevin Muscat, Craig Moore, Milan Ivanovic, Robbie Hooker, Matt Bingley, Robert Enes, Ned Zelic, Aurelio Vidmar, Graham Arnold, Paul Trimboli.
